correctness.rationale: The unique minimizers separate by columns. For A0, leading principal minors 1,2,2 establish SPD, while squared column norms 3,35,126 yield positive diagonal M0. The enlarged second-column normal equations [[3,9],[9,35]]c=[1,3] give c=(1/3,0), making M1 rank 2; exact residuals 509/315 and 97/63 differ by 8/105. In n=2, a full-diagonal-plus-one-offdiagonal pattern remains triangular with both diagonal entries positive (untouched diagonal SPAI coefficient and positive diagonal of A inverse), proving minimality. For A_epsilon, det A=2-8e-e²>0 on (0,sqrt(18)-4); symbolic least squares gives c1=(e²+7e+8)/(2(e²+6e+12)), c2=-e/(2(e²+6e+12)), det M1=-5e/[3(e²+6e+12)(e²+10e+126)] and positive squared objective gap (e²+7e+8)²/[2(e²+6e+12)(e²+10e+35)]. Rank-two limiting AM1 with nonzero singular values bounded away from zero and determinant Theta(e) implies minimum singular value Theta(e), hence condition number Theta(1/e); diagonal baseline and A remain uniformly conditioned. Independently re-derived all polynomial formulas with SymPy, checked five rational parameters and algebraically verified the 2x2 diagonal positivity; these bounded checks are not proofs of the asymptotic statement.

value.rationale: A nonsingular effective preconditioner is required for equivalently solving the original system. The precise minimum-dimensional one-entry support obstruction and a robust family with strict objective improvement but unbounded preconditioned spectral condition provide a motivated structural boundary for Frobenius approximation criteria. This is a nontrivial failure of a tempting monotonic-stability inference, not a claim that adaptive implementations necessarily select the entry, nor a numerical frequency prediction. The unbounded-conditioning perturbation complements the sharp exact rank collapse and clarifies why small-residual invertibility bounds are needed.

final_claim: For A0=[[1,1,1],[1,3,5],[1,5,10]] SPD, enlarging the full diagonal permitted support by the single position (1,2) decreases Frobenius residual squared by 8/105 while changing the unique optimal right sparse approximate inverse from an invertible diagonal M0 to rank-2 M1; no such single-entry failure is possible below dimension 3. For 0<epsilon<sqrt(18)-4 the nearby SPD A_epsilon has nonsingular diagonal and enriched optimal inverses, positive exact objective gap and kappa_2(A_epsilon M1)=Theta(1/epsilon) while A_epsilon and A_epsilon M0 stay uniformly conditioned.
